chunks.text:
[Intro: accordion hook, one bar]
[Chorus]
Pata, pata, patatá!
Pata, pata, patatá!
Bate palma, bate o pé!
Pata, pata, patatá!
Pata, pata, patatá!
Pata, pata, patatá!
Bate palma, bate o pé!
Pata, pata, patatá!
positive_styles: gentle Brazilian forró pé-de-serra in a slow, soft xote groove
sanfona accordion is the lead instrument and carries the hook
triangle keeps a light steady pulse
lullaby-soft dynamics, warm and cozy, music for babies and toddlers
very short one-bar accordion intro, then the vocal starts
chorus melody uses only three neighbouring notes, moving step by step, very easy to sing
'pata, pata' on a repeated note, 'patatá' steps up and comes back home
the accordion answers each sung line with a short echo
the same warm young adult female lead singer throughout the whole song, identical voice, timbre and vocal register in every section, sweet and clear, natural Brazilian Portuguese
